title: Flatten a List
required_features: A refinement-level ordered sequence theory (or an equivalent inductive relational predicate) over polymorphic leaf values.
Sequence concatenation together with a proof-preserving relation connecting a nested node list to its depth-first, left-to-right leaf sequence.
A sequence representation that preserves duplicates; extensional Set equality is insufficient.
semantic_obligations: For a top-level node list, emit leaves in depth-first, left-to-right traversal order.
One x emits x exactly once.
Many children emits exactly the flattening of children at that location.
Do not reverse, reorder, deduplicate, omit, or add leaves.
Be total and pure on finite values of 'a node list.

pinned_runtime_evidence.relevant_local_example: test/current/List-Concat.sq specifies concat only by total length; test/current/List-Append.sq uses Set equality, which loses duplicate count and sequence order.

test_negative_control.stub_role: explicitly labelled deliberately incorrect scratch control; not a candidate or deliverable
test_negative_control.observed_failure: official example semantic assertion rejected an empty result instead of the required five-leaf sequence

synthesis_rationale: No contract.sq was emitted and Synquid was not invoked for synthesis: any available length-only or Set-based contract would be unsoundly weaker than the required observable order and multiplicity.
